title: pp.fft-gate-st~
description: `pp.fft-gate-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.fft-gate~`, processing left and right signals with an FFT noise gate and providing separate denoised and noisy-part stereo outputs. Its FFT block size and overlap can be set by creation arguments (default `1024 4`) or control messages, alongside threshold, gate, makeup gain, dry/wet, responsiveness-filter, and preset controls.
